adminMessage.title: Admin Message
adminMessage.description: Internal error detail for admins. Do not show to the user.

availabilityStatus.title: Availability Status
availabilityStatus.description: Current availability state for the configured handoff provider or channel.

consentAccepted.title: Consent Accepted
consentAccepted.description: True when the user has accepted consent for handoff context sharing.

consentMessage.title: Consent Message
consentMessage.description: User-facing consent message to show before sharing intake context with a human agent.

contextFieldsToShare.title: Context Fields To Share
contextFieldsToShare.description: List of configured context fields that can be shared during handoff.

contextSharingEnabled.title: Context Sharing Enabled
contextSharingEnabled.description: True when SmartIntake should share intake context during handoff.

contextSummaryJson.title: Context Summary JSON
contextSummaryJson.description: JSON summary of the context prepared for the handoff.

declinedMessage.title: Declined Message
declinedMessage.description: User-facing message to show if the user declines consent or handoff.

embeddedServiceDeploymentName.title: Embedded Service Deployment Name
embeddedServiceDeploymentName.description: Embedded Service deployment name configured for handoff.

errorCode.title: Error Code
errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code for debugging handoff failures.

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Category of error when success is false.

handoffEnabled.title: Handoff Enabled
handoffEnabled.description: True when handoff is enabled for this SmartIntake template.

handoffMessage.title: Handoff Message
handoffMessage.description: User-facing message explaining the handoff path. Show this when handoff is available.

handoffReady.title: Handoff Ready
handoffReady.description: True when all handoff configuration and readiness checks pass.

handoffUrl.title: Handoff URL
handoffUrl.description: URL or launch target for the configured handoff experience, when available.

messagingChannelDeveloperName.title: Messaging Channel Developer Name
messagingChannelDeveloperName.description: Messaging channel developer name configured for handoff.

offlineMessage.title: Offline Message
offlineMessage.description: User-facing message to show when live handoff is unavailable.

providerType.title: Provider Type
providerType.description: Type of handoff provider configured for this template.

queueDeveloperName.title: Queue Developer Name
queueDeveloperName.description: Queue developer name configured for handoff routing.

readinessWarningsJson.title: Readiness Warnings JSON
readinessWarningsJson.description: JSON list of setup warnings found while checking handoff readiness.

requiresConsent.title: Requires Consent
requiresConsent.description: True when user consent is required before handoff can proceed.

success.title: Success
success.description: True when the handoff plan was loaded successfully.

triggerMessage.title: Trigger Message
triggerMessage.description: User-facing message that explains why handoff is being offered.

userMessage.title: User Message
userMessage.description: User-facing handoff status or error message. Show this when present.
